title: Meet the new James Bond: Robert Pattinson
gist: Robert Pattinson has been cast as the new James Bond, replacing Daniel Craig, in a Denis Villeneuve-directed film under Amazon MGM, which bought creative control from Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson; his strong 2026 box office record helped, while his Batman schedule is now uncertain.

insights.claim: Robert Pattinson has been cast as James Bond, succeeding Daniel Craig, with Denis Villeneuve directing the next untitled Bond film.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: First major creative decision of the Amazon-controlled Bond franchise; a key test of Amazon's IP strategy.

insights.claim: Longtime Bond stewards Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson no longer have creative control of the franchise, having sold the rights to Amazon MGM for $20 million.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Amazon now owns creative direction of one of film's most valuable franchises, a long-term content asset.
insights.locator: But Pattinson is a logical choice

insights.claim: Pattinson's 2026 films The Drama, Primetime, and The Odyssey all recouped their production costs, a box office record that likely supported his Bond casting.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Bankable lead talent de-risks Amazon MGM's Bond reboot investment.
insights.locator: Pattinson’s box office record this year

insights.claim: Pattinson's Bond commitment creates uncertainty for DC's Batman franchise, with The Batman 2 delayed to 2028 and a third film not assured after James Gunn and Peter Safran's departure from DC Studios.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: DC Studios franchise pipeline risk rises amid leadership turnover and talent conflicts.
insights.locator: It’s unclear how his Bond commitments
